The Deviation of curb, gutter, and sidewalk improvements per DCMC Section 17-5-030(D) is compatible with the street improvements on 12600 South and 1015 East

Commissioner Squire moved to APPROVE the Subdivision Plat Amendment as requested by Troy Blundell for Carol Lee Subdivision, Application 2024-0191-SUB, subject to the following: Finding: 1. There is good cause for the vacation or amendment, and no public street or municipal utility easement has been vacated or amended. Conditions of Approval: 1. That all requirements of the Draper City Engineering, Public Works, Building, Planning, and Fire Divisions are satisfied throughout the development of the site and the construction of all buildings on the site
Commissioner Fowler moved to ADJOURN. Chair Adams adjourned the meeting at approximately 7:13 PM
